        greedy_tp += g_tp
        greedy_fp += g_fp
        greedy_fn += g_fn

        best_idx = int(np.argmax(logprobs))
        best_sample = samples[best_idx]
        l_tp, l_fp, l_fn = entity_strict_match(
            best_sample.get("entities", []), gold.get("entities", []))

        lp_sel_fp += l_fp
